title: Flashback practice sheet
subject: English
unit: Summer 2: Time Traveller and Off with Her Head!
source: Written for english/y5 lesson 91 (Flashback practice sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 91: Grammar: flashback and the past perfect tense. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Simple past (now in the story)
Past perfect (earlier)
rows: Nana had told him never to touch it.
He had smelled it once before, at camp.
He had seen the tower from the hill.

blocks.h: Into and out of a flashback

parts.text: Trigger: The clock's tick reminded him of something.
Signal and past perfect: Years before, Nana had lifted him up to see its face.
Memory detail: She had whispered, "This clock keeps more than time."
Return: Now, alone in the hall, he understood.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A short flashback with a clear way in and out

head: Not this
This
rows: He ran to the square. Nana gave him the clock key when he was six.
He ran to the square. Years before, when he was six, Nana had given him the clock key.

keywords.def: a part of a story that goes back to an earlier time
had + verb, for something that happened before another past event
words that show a time change: years before, he remembered
the form of a verb that shows time

questions.q: Change to past perfect: She locks the door.
Core: complete 8 sentences with the past perfect, then write a three-sentence flashback
Extend: write a flashback for your own story plan
questions.a: A flashback with trigger, memory and return

questions.q: Stretch: use a semi-colon to link the memory and the present
questions.a: For example: Nana had warned him; now he knew why.

questions.q: Which sentence uses the past perfect?
options: He had found the key the day before.
questions.a: A) He had found the key the day before.. had found shows something that happened before another past event.
